name: Lowrey
description: Lowrey T2 combo organ listing copy. History sourced from Reverb listings and organforum.com discussion of the Lowrey T2 / Gibson G-201 relationship, cross-referenced against the existing Gibson & Kalamazoo tree (gibson-kalamazoo-tree.json) since the T2 and G-201 share a manufacturer and core electronics. Deliberately did not restate specific G-201-vs-T2 feature differences (e.g. Fuzz Bass/Sax Bass) that couldn't be reconciled with the already-researched G-201 copy already in the catalog, to avoid contradicting it. Only one model is in the live catalog, so this tree has a single leaf.

nodes.label: Lowrey T2
nodes.copy:
Every Lowrey combo organ we restore for sale goes through the same meticulous process we're known for, with dozens of hours devoted to bringing each instrument to exceptional playing condition. We prioritize period-correct vintage components whenever possible, and turn to the best available reproduction parts when originals are no longer viable — always working to preserve the instrument's original character and tone. The result is an organ that plays and sounds better than it likely has in decades.

As parent company Chicago Musical Instruments (CMI) owned both Gibson and the Lowrey Organ Company through the 1960s, the T2 was Lowrey's own badge for essentially the same organ Gibson sold as the G-201 — built by Lowrey itself, and sharing significant circuitry with the earlier Gibson G-101/Kalamazoo K-101. It's a two-manual combo organ with an optional bass pedal unit, offering a wide tonal palette across two large banks of tone switches governing voicing, bass register, and vibrato. Lowrey also sold a matching amplifier alongside the T2, built around a scaled-down version of CMI's Sabre Reverb circuit with an original Jensen C12N speaker and a side-mounted horn.

Features:
- Cleaned, Lubricated & Restored Key Contacts and Switches
- New Electrolytic Capacitors
- Fully Restored Power Supply
- Serviced Bass Pedal Assembly
- CEPCo's Expert Tuning & Voicing Setup
- Cleaned All Tabs, Switches & Connectors
- All Voltages Checked & Calibrated for Optimum Performance
- New Cables
